rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>I didn't understand it at the time.
But now I think it's because he was
the same being as <color(4)>Barrel<ce()>.

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>He rarely showed emotion,
but he was a man who sometimes revealed
something like a bottomless hatred.

<on()><sp(20)>That may have been directed
at <color(4)>Barrel<ce()>, his other self.

<on()><sp(20)>...I kept thinking about what Dr. <color(6)>Bardona<ce()> meant
by telling me to find <color(4)>Barrel<ce()>.

<on()><sp(20)>What that meant
became clear to me in the fight moments ago.
rows.notes: Reworded to avoid the font's lowercase j ("just").

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>The key to the <book(1)>Baldora Drive<endbook()> is <color(4)>Barrel<ce()>...
You, yourself.
<on()><sp(20)>...How do you know?

<on()><sp(20)><color(5)>Berkt<ce()> said he himself was the key.
So... the same must be true for you.

<on()><sp(20)>But the two worlds are completely different.
Shouldn't it be impossible for the same person to exist in both?

<on()><sp(20)>Nothing identical exists
because tiny differences kept repeating.
But if their root is the same...
rows.notes: Compressed to fit the 110-character visible limit.

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>The <book(1)>Baldora Drive<endbook()>'s key, <color(4)>Barrel<ce()>,
may have ended up
becoming two people.
rows.notes: Tag order corrected to match source: <book(1)> (Baldora Drive) precedes <color(4)> (Barrel).

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>...<color(4)>Faye<ce()>.
Why did you keep it hidden?

<on()><sp(20)>...I was using you
for my own purposes.

<on()><sp(20)>I've caused trouble for everyone too...
This is the last time I'll fight alongside you.
<on()><sp(20)>Then why did you decide to tell us?

<on()><sp(20)>It's because...
it became too painful to keep lying.

<on()><sp(20)>Everyone here fights with their own convictions.
Hiding who I really was
felt like it was disgracing that.

<on()><sp(20)>I want to stay as one of you...
So I felt I needed to tell you.
<on()><sp(20)>But now...
<on()><sp(20)>Wait.

<on()><sp(20)>I can't take it all in yet,
and honestly, I'm still half in disbelief.
But I won't turn back now.
rows.notes: Compressed to fit the 110-character visible limit; the source's "having come this far" clause is implied rather than spelled out.

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>You've supported and protected me all this time -
if they're <color(4)>Faye<ce()>'s words, I'll believe them.
<on()><sp(20)>I'll keep fighting.
<on()><sp(20)><color(4)>Barrel<ce()>...
<on()><sp(20)>Either way, there's only one thing to do.

<on()><sp(20)>From here, we're heading
for the <book(1)>Baldora Drive<endbook()>
to shut it down.
<on()><sp(20)>I'm counting on you... <color(4)>Faye<ce()>, <color(4)>Barrel<ce()>.
<on()><sp(20)>But, I've already...
<on()><sp(20)>We need <color(4)>Faye<ce()>.

<on()><sp(20)>That's right.
Without you, no one would have
noticed this crisis at all.
<on()><sp(20)>So please, fight with us to the end.
